subject: Invite list prioritization + tracking fallbacks (Apr 12 webinar)
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Invite list prioritization + tracking fallbacks (Apr 12 webinar)

Team —

Following up from yesterday's ops sync: attached is a draft "priority matrix" for the Apr 12 webinar (priority_matrix.xlsx). Goal is to map segments -> send tiers -> reminder cadence -> primary/fallback tracking link.

Key asks:
- Marissa: can you review the reminder cadence (2/5/10 day reminders) and confirm send windows for US/EU/APAC?
- Aisha: please upload the seed lists (prod-eng, infra-platform, security-ctos) to the shared sheet by EOD 3/23.
- Vivek: need guidance on throttling thresholds for high-volume segments (we don't want to blow quota during the 2-day warm window).

Tracking fallbacks we need:
- Primary: event page with UTM params (redwood & partner tags)
- Fallback 1: short redirect hosted on redwood domain (no JS), for clients blocking tracking pixels
- Fallback 2: plain link to Eventbrite page (no UTM) as last resort

I've attached the initial email copy (invite-copy-v2.docx) — Marissa, please iterate subject lines A/B and we can finalize by 3/24. Also added a seed_lists_agg.csv stub for format.

Thanks,
Irene
Director, Events
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-22T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invite list prioritization + tracking fallbacks (Apr 12 webinar)

Thanks Irene — quick notes inline.

On Wed, Mar 22, 2028 at 09:12 AM Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> Following up from yesterday's ops sync: attached is a draft "priority matrix" for the Apr 12 webinar (priority_matrix.xlsx). Goal is to map segments -> send tiers -> reminder cadence -> primary/fallback tracking link.

- Reminder cadence: 2/5/10 days sounds good for US/EU. For APAC I'd compress to 3/7/14 to avoid late-night sends.
- Subject lines: I'll test (A) "How top infra teams cut inference cost 3x" and (B) "Webinar: Make LLM inference predictable — live Apr 12". We'll keep A for engineers, B for architects.
- Tracking: for partner co-promo we need two distinct UTMs per partner (utm_source=partner, utm_partner=orion). Can we get that confirmed from Daniel (cc below) before finalizing redirects?

I'll draft the final send plan and push the two link variants to the tracker. Marissa

From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@orioncloud.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-22T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invite list prioritization + tracking fallbacks (Apr 12 webinar)

Hi Irene / Marissa —

Orion is on board for co-promo. A few requirements from our side:
- Primary UTM: utm_source=orion&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=rdw_apr12
- Please also generate a fallback shortlink hosted on redwood.com: we will use that in any mail clients that strip query params.
- We can provide a partner logo (attached) and one sentence partner blurb.

Event page URL: https://orioncloud.com/events/llm-inference-apr12
We also prefer an explicit campaign id: campaign_id=OR-0428 if you can append to links.

Happy to sync if you want to run through the link matrix quickly.

Best,
Daniel Park
Head of Developer Marketing
Orion Cloud

Attachment: orion_logo_2x.png

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@orioncloud.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-22T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invite list prioritization + tracking fallbacks (Apr 12 webinar)

Thanks Daniel — that's clear and helpful. I've incorporated Orion's UTM and campaign_id into the matrix and added the fallback shortlink approach.

Action items (owners):
- Marissa: generate final two link variants and push to tracker (primary + fallback shortlink) — due 3/24 noon PT.
- Aisha: upload seed lists to the shared sheet and add a "do-not-contact" suppression column — due 3/23 EOD.
- Vivek: confirm throttling rules (max_rate=1200 epm for high-volume segments) — due 3/24 EOD.
- Olga: confirm partner creative placement in the invite (logo + 1-line blurb) — done once Daniel's file is in Drive.

I've attached the updated priority matrix and a final invite copy v2. We'll run a small seed test (5k recipients across two segments) the week of 3/29 and then open full sends on 4/02.

Thanks everyone —
Irene

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>
